modelOverview: Introduced at Baselworld 2016, the ref. 5396 is Patek Philippe's compact Calatrava-cased Annual Calendar with moon phase, powered by the self-winding Calibre 324 S QA LU 24H/303. Its 38.5mm case houses a combined day/month/date annual calendar with a 24-hour and moon phase sub-dial at 6 o'clock, requiring correction only once a year at the end of February. It succeeded the earlier 5396 with sector dial and is offered across white, rose and yellow gold with a range of dial finishes.

5396G-014.description: The 5396G-014 is the white gold execution of Patek Philippe's Annual Calendar Moon Phase, combining a sunburst charcoal grey dial with the manufacture's Calibre 324 S QA LU 24H/303 self-winding movement and its signature combined 24-hour/moon phase sub-dial. Introduced at Baselworld 2016, it needs correcting only once a year and carries the Patek Philippe Seal. Every piece we offer is sourced and fully authenticated before sale.
